notes.body:
- **Fixed:** Jinava's shield only stops Spells. Dagger of Death and the other plain Treasures aren't Spells, so they can target her.
- **The piles, from the End Turn button down:** Void, Graveyard, Treasure Chest, Deck. The Treasure Chest no longer sits right under the button.
- **The Deck Builder's grid keeps still.** Cards there tilt only in the big card view (hover or right-click); a foil card still shows its foil in the grid.

- **Cards lean toward your mouse.** Hover a card in your hand, in the Deck Builder or in the big card view and it tilts in 3D, as if you pressed it where the pointer is; the big preview leans as you move over the small card. It settles back when you move away.
- **Rainbow foil.** A foil card shimmers with rainbow bands that roll as it tilts. Nothing gives foils out yet - they are coming as achievement rewards.

- **Best of 3.** The Bot Match screen has a new "Match: Best of 1 / Best of 3" choice (it remembers yours), against the computer and in hot-seat. Between games the game-over screen keeps the score and offers **Next Game**; the loser of the last game goes first. Rematch and New Match after a decided match start a fresh best of 3.
- **Sideboards.** The Deck Builder has a third tab, **Sideboard**: up to 15 cards beside your deck. A card's copies in the deck and the sideboard share its limit. Before games 2 and 3 of a best of 3 you get a simple swap screen - click a card to move one copy across; Ready lights up when your deck is its own size again. The swap lasts for that match only. The computer never sideboards.

- **The designer's debug panel** (F12 in a match): cards to any zone or field, Energy and Life, click tools on the board, End Turn, the hung-game tools (close stuck dialogs, skip a waiting question, resolve the Stack, save the state to a file) and a peek at the opponent. It opens only on a machine holding the key file, never online, and a match it touched is not recorded.

- **The Wind/Darkness batch: fifteen new cards.** Wind: Confiscate Magic, Raise the Eyrie (with the Eagle token), Double Up, Reset the Race, In Their Wake, Hoarding Mystic. Darkness: Pestify, Blister Hatchery, Ravaging Boils, Ossuary Fiend, White Night, Doomed Fate, Empty Hands, Blind Bargain, Necroticist.
- On the VS screen the computer's seat carries its Guardian's name, as it does in the match.

- **Mordrec's** Undead token now goes on the Stack, so it can be answered.
- **Blaze Swarm Drone** works like Magic's Narcomoeba: milled, its trigger goes on the Stack, and you're asked as it resolves. This also fixes the stacked pickers you saw with Quick Cast Pyromancer.
- **Card changes:** Crosscurrent also draws a card; Ocean Rider is Common; Communal Work finds up to two unlimited Workers; Snared Up Immobilizes for a turn (they can't move on their next turn either).
- **The Void and the Treasure Chest have swapped places** in the right-hand column, to try out.
- **Avatars:** 31 new ones to pick from. The computer's seat now wears its Guardian's avatar, in the match and on the VS screen; where there's no full picture yet, the VS screen shows the avatar head.

- **Fixed:** Nightmare Eater's Onslaught now fires when it attacks a Guardian, too.
- **Fixed:** Miasm makes its caster sacrifice, discard and send a card to the Void as well, not only the opponent.
- **Gloom looks better:** a churning smoke over the field with violet in its folds, thicker for each layer.
- An Attack or Magic pushed to 0 or below (Demoralized) shows as 0 on the board, as Defense and Resistance do.
- The phase buttons and Log sit 2 px higher on the centre stripe.
- **Stats:** the scroll bar no longer covers the right-hand numbers.
- **New achievements:** win a tournament; win a Swiss tournament; win without ever having a Worker in play; win with no Summon cards in your deck; set off 10 Traps in one game; discard 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 cards in one game. **Untouched** now means your Guardian never lost Life all game (a heal afterwards doesn't hide it); it counts games played from this build on.

- **The Treasure batch is complete:** Stratospheric Collapse (Lightning) and The Endless Deep (Water), the last two of thirty.
- The Jann token (from Jann's Lamp) has its art.
